name: DIGI-MENTAL
summary:
DIGI-MENTAL is an immersive application designed to promote wellbeing awareness among adolescents and young adults. Intended for youth workers and educators in educational and community settings, it introduces young people to the concepts of stress, anxiety and burnout inside a calming virtual SPA environment.
